title: Concept: Erlang term decoded from untrusted bytes in elixir — review required
description: In elixir, an Erlang term is decoded from a binary. The decoder will create atoms, funs and pids, so a remote payload can consume the finite atom table or produce terms that later code mishandles. The :safe flag limits creation but does not make external bytes equal to validated data.
applicability: elixir services that decode terms from queues, caches or sockets.
risk: Resource exhaustion and unexpected object construction; HIGH severity.
